items.title: Novo submits sickle cell drug; Flagship, Gates Foundation deepen ties
items.summary: Novo views the medicine, acquired in a billion-dollar deal, as a future blockbuster. Meanwhile, a pair of startups forged an RNA editing pact and Astellas lined up two new trials in pancreatic cancer.

items.title: STAT+: Blackstone backs Pfizer’s bet on monthly obesity treatment
items.summary: Pfizer spent up to $10 billion to buy Metsera last year. Now, it’s bringing in private equity behemoth Blackstone to help pay for the deal.

items.title: Windward prices $175M 首次公開上市（IPO） to advance China-licensed lung drugs
items.summary: The Swiss biotech, which pocketed another $50 million through a concurrent private share sale to Sanofi, is developing a potential competitor to the blockbuster asthma treatment Tezspire.

items.title: Blackstone bets $1.5B on Pfizer’s obesity drug
items.summary: The deal will support a sprawling 第三期試驗 program for a monthly GLP-1 shot Pfizer acquired by winning a bidding war for the drug’s previous owner, Metsera.
